description: Use this when the person asks what a fax costs, or before a fax they’ll pay for is sent. The price of sending one fax of a number of pages with XipFax to a fax number, without a plan, from XipFax’s price list. plan_covers says whether the plan covers a fax to the number, for a person who has one.

fax_number.description: A fax number, with or without its +1: +1 202 555 0143.

pages.description: The pages to send, from 1 to 250.

name: quote_fax

plan_covers.description: Whether the plan covers a fax to the number: sent on the plan, its pages count there instead of the price.

price.description: What the fax costs without a plan, and on the plan where it doesn’t cover the number.

amount_minor.description: In the currency’s smallest unit: cents.

price_list.description: The version of XipFax’s price list the quote is from.

price_shown.description: The price as XipFax prints it: $4.99.

terms.description: How the price is made, as XipFax’s pages say it: the first pages, then each page.

title: Quote a fax
